angle: DL/EDGE: Run-the-Hoop lateral force (Hoop G) as a pass-rush tiebreaker for linemen without a 3-cone; year-standardized; baseline = log pick + weight + EDGE share + NGS + official 10-yd split and 3-cone
metric_name: Hoop G: sideways force a lineman holds for half a second while circling the hoop (peak half-second path-perpendicular acceleration, g, z within Combine year, noise-corrected, one-run reliability 0.41)
headline_number: 0.6 pressures per 450-rush season per sd [90% -0.4, 1.7], n=90 (pick 100 vs 80). Complete-case, no-3-cone rushers (n=56): held-out R2 +11.6 pts [-6.8, 32.2], log score +0.050/rusher [-0.020, 0.126]. Frozen rule: plus calls beat forecast 4/9 [17-75%] vs 19% matched no-call, permutation p=0.05; 2025 clean test 0/2.
what_changed_from_previous: Football: decision card leads (Downs, Brinson, Ezeiruaku + Phillips film flag) with one call, one film cue and rotation caveat each; robustness table and screening scaffolding moved to one Limitations bullet; rho=0.10 link replaced by drill-protocol recommendation (record hoop peak g, two runs 0.41->0.58, every DL runs 3-cone); hero shows Solomon (hit) vs Ezeiruaku (plus, no hit) on the same time axis. DS: complete-case comparisons without imputed times (no-3-cone n=56; 3-cone n=34) with held-out R2 and log score intervals; frozen rule scored by leave-one-class-out calibration, exact binomial intervals, matched (role x class) no-call base rate, 2025 separate, 5000-shuffle permutation test of the hit-rate gap; within-player check at matched speed (2.5-4.5 yd/s) with a random-intercept mixed model and attenuation-corrected r (0.07 [-0.39, 0.63]); film-trace claims rewritten as cues, 'change-of-direction not bend' claim dropped. Writeup: coach-repeatable definition, plain-language model paragraph, one confident lede, calibration restatement cut and numbers reconciled (table only), pass-rush-drill aside removed. Viz: Fig1 adds an all-runner drill-vs-NFL scatter strip (n=78) with featured players circled and a full legend; Fig2 split into a sorted forest with n labels and a held-out panel with shaded shuffle strip, unit in R-squared percentage points, one p; Fig3 now plus calls only, split tuning vs 2025, larger sparklines with y-scale, matched base-rate bands, honest title.
open_risks: No clean confirmation: 2025 plus calls are 0 of 2 and all 4 hits are 2023-24 EDGEs; best-of-14 multiplicity p=0.12.
Complete-case no-3-cone gain (+11.6 pts) has an interval spanning zero; on 3-cone runners adding Hoop G overfits badly (-73 pts on n=34).
Mechanism unproven: matched-speed NFL sideways g is mostly noise (per-snap ICC 0.03), corrected r 0.07 with a wide interval.
Fig 1 featured players are chosen by hand (two plus EDGEs, top/bottom interior), mitigated by the all-runner scatter strip.
Fig 3 drops the low-interior rows; low interior Hoop G is only mentioned as a film flag.
